Thanks Samantha — Fri afternoon works for Redwood. A couple of notes from the infra side:

1) For the controlled load trial we prefer a 60–90 minute steady-state run followed by a 30-minute spike window. If you want a longer soak, we can schedule the spike for a follow-up window.

2) To avoid throttling surprises please share: expected concurrency, typical request size (tokens per request), and any custom model variants you plan to exercise. A small CSV with sample prompt examples is ideal.

3) We'll bring the prebuilt prompt pack and a short list of recommended quantization/model profiles. Monica will surface the console access instructions and labs.

Proposed final slot: Fri 2026-11-27 12:30–15:30 PST (includes the load window at 14:00–15:30). If that works, Naomi — can you send the invite and indicate whether the load trial will be run from Oakside's environment or Redwood's dedicated pool?
